faqs: LankaPex is a platform designed to help Sri Lankan shops manage digital credit and connect with customers and delivery partners.
Shop Owners, Customers and Delivery Drivers can register. Platform Administrators are managed separately.
Can a Shop Owner manage customer credit?
Yes. LankaPex supports customer credit accounts, credit sales, repayments and outstanding-balance records.
Can customers buy products on credit?
Credit purchasing and customer ordering are part of the planned commerce workflow. Availability depends on the development stage and shop approval.
Does LankaPex send payment reminders through WhatsApp?
LankaPex can prepare a reminder and open WhatsApp with a prefilled message. The shop owner must review and send it manually.
Proposed subscription plans include a free starter tier and paid business tiers. Final pricing is not yet confirmed.
